import copy,importlib.util,json
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools import g01_collect_parallel as collect
from src.envs import pair_v2_g01_policy as policy
from src.tools.t01_partition import ROOT,sha_file
path=ROOT/'configs/g01_test40_initial.json'
plan=json.loads(path.read_text())
scenes=[scene for unit in plan['units'] for scene in unit['scenes']]
assert len(scenes)==len(set(scenes)) and set(scenes)==policy.TEST_SCENES
assert not set(scenes)&policy.TRAIN_SCENES
assert plan['policy_version']==policy.TEST_VERSION and plan['per_scene_class_cap']==6
assert plan['field_of_view']==60 and plan['seed']==0 and plan['max_unity_instances']==8
benchmark=collect.benchmark_stage('results/gen_train_concurrency_s15_02.json',6)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('g01_test_plan_submit',ROOT/'scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py')
submit=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(submit)
observed=submit.budget_state(ROOT)
reserved=copy.deepcopy(observed);units=[]
for unit in plan['units']:
 collect.validate_selection(unit['scenes'],unit['concurrency'],'test')
 assert unit['parent_timeout_seconds']==collect.required_timeout(unit['scenes'],6,'test')
 assert unit['gpus']==1 and unit['concurrency']==6 and unit['requested_host'] is None
 assert unit['command']==['python3','-u','-m',collect.MODULE,'--name',unit['name'],'--scenes',*unit['scenes'],'--concurrency','6','--benchmark-source','results/gen_train_concurrency_s15_02.json','--timeout-seconds',str(unit['parent_timeout_seconds']),'--partition','test']
 seconds=submit.wall_seconds(unit['pbs_walltime']);assert seconds>=unit['parent_timeout_seconds']+30
 assert submit.budget_group('T01',unit['name'],unit['command'],'G01')=='G01'
 submit.validate_request('T01',1,seconds,unit['name'],reserved,'G01')
 cost=seconds/3600*submit.positive_rate(observed['charge_policy']['rates'][submit.queue_for_gpus(1)])
 reserved['accounted_or_reserved_by_task']['T01']+=cost
 reserved['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget']['G01']+=cost
 reserved['accounted_or_reserved_total']+=cost
 reserved['submissions'].append({'name':unit['name']})
 units.append({**unit,'requested_wall_seconds':seconds,'planned_full_reservation_charged_gpu_hours':cost})
print('G01_TEST40_FROZEN_PLAN: '+json.dumps({'config_file':str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),'config_sha256':sha_file(path),'benchmark':benchmark,'observed_budget':observed,'units':units,'planned_after_all_units_reserved_by_subbudget':reserved['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget'],'planned_after_all_units_total':reserved['accounted_or_reserved_total'],'train_test_overlap':sorted(set(scenes)&policy.TRAIN_SCENES),'scope':'fixed evaluation generation plan and full-wall reservations, not executed outcomes; actual submitter rechecks live budget per job'},sort_keys=True))
